name: Sidereal-Ria
description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, asteroid belt proximity emerge like the bones of the planet.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. Carpet-flora blooms all at once after each rare rain, turning whole basins scarlet overnight.
Local legend among spacers says the planet hums on a frequency just below hearing. Instruments confirm it. Nobody agrees on the source.
There is money in copper, silicon, solar potential and titanium and history in the rocks, and the two keep interfering with each other. Mediators do brisk business at inflated rates.
